title: Governor of Sutos/Quotes
summary:
"It can't be! It's been ten years but I'll never forget - San Grier!"
- Governor of Sutos to Grier (Like Father, Unlike Son)

"What's this? After only half a day of peace?"
- Governor of Sutos to Grier, after he spots the fighting on the beach (Like Father, Unlike Son)
